images.author: Tony Gálvez
images.why: Classic Meeting of Waters photograph, clearly distinguishing the dark Negro from the muddy Solimões near Manaus. Lower-resolution fallback: 1024px Flickr variant; larger original unverified.

images.author: Terry Feuerborn
images.why: Documented 2002 photograph of the contrasting rivers meeting at Manaus. Lower-resolution fallback: 1024px Flickr variant; larger original unverified. Noncommercial licence.

images.author: William Daniels / Panos
images.why: Documentary photograph of pirogues and sand collectors on the Oubangui at Bangui, with river and port context. CDN URL references a 3000×2000 source; reuse permission is not stated.

images.author: Apodidae
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies this river-crossing scene as Bangui, Central African Republic. Lower-resolution fallback: 1024px Flickr variant; larger original unverified.

images.author: Daniel Eliashevsky
images.why: Strongest verified-resolution option: 3703×2083 aerial of Kyiv’s Dnipro, bridge and green riverbanks. Taken in July 2021; suitable for a river-centred 9:10 crop.

images.author: Daniel Eliashevsky
images.why: Recognisable Kyiv pedestrian bridge and cityscape across the Dnipro, photographed from above. Original-file URL; dimensions were not exposed in the retrieved page.

images.author: Pavel Shakotko
images.why: Summer aerial explicitly identified as Kyiv’s Dnipro River, with abundant greenery and urban context. Original-file URL; dimensions unverified.

images.author: David Stanley
images.why: The Irrawaddy with the Ava and Sagaing bridges linking Sagaing to Mandalay; documented 2018 photograph. Lower-resolution fallback: 1024px Flickr variant; larger original unverified.

images.author: Yoshitaka Ando
images.why: Sunrise over the Irrawaddy’s Yadanabon Bridge between Sagaing and Mandalay. Lower-resolution fallback: 1024px Flickr variant; larger original unverified. Licence restricts commercial use and derivatives.

images.author: Helen Gray
images.why: Personally documented Bagan river journey: silhouetted boat against an orange-purple sunset, with water prominent. Attractive colour alternative; the available file is a web-sized version, with dimensions unverified.

images.author: Matti Barthel / ETH Zurich
images.why: Research photograph explicitly identifying the Fimi–Kasai confluence in DR Congo, with striking dark and rusty-red water contrast. Strong geographic provenance; downloadable dimensions unverified.

images.author: Matti Barthel
images.why: Documented drone photograph of the Sankuru–Kasai confluence, showing broad contrasting currents and vegetated banks. Lower-resolution fallback: 1024px Flickr variant; larger original unverified. Licence restricts commercial use and derivatives.
